description: Today, Democratic nominee for governor Cindy Holscher launched her newest television ad, “Sunflowers,” highlighting the need for firm guardrails around new data center development in Kansas. The ad will air statewide on broadcast, cable, and digital platforms starting today.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Cindy Holscher for Kansas
title: Cindy Holscher Launches New Television Ad Highlighting Need for Firm Guardrails on Data Centers | Cindy Holscher for Governor
